text: いつも　おいそがしそう　ですね　オレですか？

structure.jp: いつも　おいそがしそう　ですね
structure.en: you always look so busy, don't you

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.span: おいそがしそう　です
patterns.explanation: Dropping the last い of a describing word and adding そう means 'looks, seems'. The お in front shows respect to the listener. おいそがしそう です = 'you seem busy'.
